The largest cryptocurrency slumped to an overnight low of $76,400 before recovering some of the decline. Ether ETH$2,244.25 momentarily hit $2,170 before rebounding to around $2,220. [...] Binance said around $3 billion of the stolen assets has been frozen and withdrawals remain paused. TRM Labs and Elliptic attributed the attack to North Korea-linked hackers.
Tokens the hacker held and sold led the rebound, with ethena gaining 8.4% and pepe rising 7.3% after uniswap and aave fell around 11% on Thursday.

Options traders turned defensive, with five of the six highest-volume bitcoin options puts and the 25-delta skew rising across time frames in both bitcoin and ether. [...] BTC steady, ETH exits:BTC fell 3.1% over 24 hours while open interest fell only 1.4%, so a small amount of money came in during the drop. ETH fell 4% while its open interest fell 5.8%, so a small amount of money left. BTC funding is positive and has increased, which means longs are paying shorts and perp traders are still tilted long. ETH funding is positive but has decreased, so that tilt is fading.
